I am an old woman here in Tigray, and this small barley plot is close to my home. The rains have been uncertain these past years, so I must be careful with what little money I have. I will put some DAP at planting like the extension people tell us, and spread the manure from my oxen and goats as I always do. My sons and daughter-in-law will help me with the weeding and harvest, so I do not need to pay outside hands for such a small piece of land.
